The '''1933–34 [[Super League Greece|Panhellenic Championship]]''' was the sixth season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. It was held in two groups, the South and the North.

The South Group was formed by 6 teams which resulted as follows:
*'''[[Athens Football Clubs Association|Athenian]] Championship''': The first 4 teams of the ranking.
*'''[[Piraeus Football Clubs Association|Piraeus']] Championship''': The first 2 teams of the ranking.

The North Group was formed by 4 teams which resulted as follows:
*'''[[Macedonia Football Clubs Association|Macedonian]] Championship''': The first 4 teams of the ranking.

The winners of the 2 groups competed in a two-legged final. The national category, in which the clubs that did not qualify, competed in the regional championships, was abolished.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://srv-web1.parliament.gr/display_doc.asp?item=43502&seg=|title=Εφημερίδα "Αθλητικά Χρονικά", φύλλο της|website=srv-web1.parliament.gr}}</ref> So the clubs played first in the regional championships and then in the national category. Essentially, this arrangement was made to favor [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]], which had initially been relegated the previous year, after it had refused to participate in the ranking matches. The decision for the abolition of the National category was taken by the General Assembly of the [[Hellenic Football Federation|HFF]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://srv-web1.parliament.gr/display_doc.asp?item=43502&seg=|title=Φύλλο εφημερίδας "Αθλητικά Χρονικά"|website=srv-web1.parliament.gr}}</ref> which was held on September 23-24, 1933. Thus, [[PAOK FC|PAOK]] returned to the first division, after a year of absence from the top division and staying in the Macedonian championship, due to demotion. The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point'' - ''Loss: 0 points''.
